title: QA-Board project configuration (qaboard.yaml)
description: Configures how `qa` runs your code and how QA-Board shows the results. Subprojects' qaboard.yaml are merged on top of their parents'. Docs: https://samsung.github.io/qaboard/docs/project-init

root.description: Don't merge the qaboard.yaml of the parent folders, e.g. in a git submodule.

include.description: A YAML file (relative to the root qaboard.yaml) merged under this one.

branches.description: Globs of the branches people can tune from the web app. `{subproject}` and `{subproject.name}` are replaced.

name.description: The project's id, often the git repository's path, e.g. `group/repo`. Subprojects get `<name>/<subfolder>`. `{root_path}` and `{project_path}` are replaced.

url.description: The git repository's URL, e.g. `git@github.com:group/repo.git`. The same in all subprojects.

remote_type.description: Unused: the git host's type is found from `url`.

entrypoint.description: The Python file with your `run` (and `postprocess`, `metadata`, `iter_inputs`...) functions, relative to the root qaboard.yaml.

reference_branch.description: The branch whose latest commit is the default reference. Default: master.

milestones.description: Branches, tags or commits shown as milestones to compare with. Their results are never deleted.

inputs.description: How `qa` finds the inputs. All these settings can be changed per input type (inputs.types) and per batch. Other keys are allowed: your entrypoint's `iter_inputs` gets them. Docs: https://samsung.github.io/qaboard/docs/inputs

allow_duplicate_batches.description: When several batch files define a batch, run all of them instead of the last one.

platforms.description: The platforms people can choose in the web app's tuning form.

types.description: Types of inputs (images, videos...) with their own settings. Choose them with `qa --type`, or `type:` in batches.

default.description: The type used when none is given.

input_type.description: Settings for this type of inputs, overriding the ones under inputs.

batches_files.description: The files defining batches, relative to the root qaboard.yaml. Globs and `{project}`/`{subproject}` work. When several files define a batch, the last one wins.

metrics.description: The YAML file describing your metrics, relative to the root qaboard.yaml. Docs: https://samsung.github.io/qaboard/docs/computing-quantitative-metrics

style.description: CSS for the visualizations' containers, e.g. `width: 840px`.

controls.description: Controls in the web app that pass parameters to all viewers.

default_tab_details.description: The tab(s) shown first on commit pages.

action_on_existing.description: What `qa batch` does when the runs already have results. Default: run.

action_on_pending.description: What `qa batch` does when the runs are already pending. Default: wait.

output_dir_uses_database.description: Include the database in the runs' output directories.

visualizations.description: How to show the runs' output files. Docs: https://samsung.github.io/qaboard/docs/visualizations

items.description: Other keys are options of the viewer.

path.description: Path of the file in the output directory. `:name` and `(regex)` parts let people choose the file.

type.description: The viewer. Default: guessed from the extension.

artifacts.description: The files saved by `qa save-artifacts` (binaries, configurations...), so the web app can run your code for this commit. Docs: https://samsung.github.io/qaboard/docs/storage/artifacts

storage.description: Where results are saved. `{project}`, `{subproject}` and `{user}` are replaced. Docs: https://samsung.github.io/qaboard/docs/storage/where-is-the-data

runners.description: Where `qa batch` runs: locally, or on a cluster. Docs: https://samsung.github.io/qaboard/docs/using-the-qa-cli#batch-runners

default.description: Default: the first runner configured here other than local.

lsf.description: Settings of the LSF runner (bsub). `long_queue` is used to optimize parameters from the web app.

jenkins.description: The Jenkins job that runs on Windows machines, for the `windows` runner.

patterns.description: The output files compared. Default: all.

plaintext.description: Text files, compared with normalized end of lines. The others are binary. Don't set both plaintext and binary.

binary.description: Binary files. The others are text.

max_parents_depth.description: With on_reference_failed_ci, how many parents we try. Default: 5.

failed_ci_job_name.description: The CI job whose failure means the CI failed. Default: the commit's status.

gate.description: Experimental: `qa gate` fails the CI when results regress vs a reference. Docs: https://samsung.github.io/qaboard/docs/quality-gate

reference.description: A branch, milestone or commit. Default: project.reference_branch.

batches.description: The labels of the batches to check. Default: default.

max_regression.description: e.g. 5% or 0.05, for the median (or `aggregate`) over the runs.

per_test_max_regression.description: e.g. 20%, for each run vs its reference.

aggregate.description: How min, max and max_regression aggregate the runs. Default: median. Use max or mean for pass/fail (0/1) metrics. Not with per_test_max_regression.

integrations.description: Links and buttons in the web app, e.g. to start CI jobs. Docs: https://samsung.github.io/qaboard/docs/triggering-external-ci-tools

items.description: Other keys are passed to the menu item (text, href, icon, label, intent...).
